title: LLMs and self-referentiality
summary: Scott Aaronson discusses the concept of self-referentiality in large language models (LLMs), exploring how models can reason about themselves and the implications for AI safety and understanding.
highlights: The post examines how LLMs handle self-referential statements and paradoxes.
Aaronson connects self-referentiality to broader questions about machine consciousness and reasoning.
The discussion includes practical examples and theoretical insights from a leading AI researcher.
